senses.example: Vil du komme over til mig i aften?
senses.example_translation: Will you come over to my place tonight?

senses.example: Hun kom over sin frygt for hunde.
senses.example_translation: She got over her fear of dogs.

senses.example: Det gamle skib gik under i stormen.
senses.example_translation: The old ship sank in the storm.

senses.example: Mange små butikker går under i krisen.
senses.example_translation: Many small shops are going under in the crisis.

senses.example: Floden deler sig i to grene lige efter broen.
senses.example_translation: The river splits into two branches just after the bridge.

senses.text: to fork (of a road or group)
senses.example: Stien deler sig, så vi må vælge en vej.
senses.example_translation: The path forks, so we have to choose a way.

senses.text: to cover (one's nose, ears, eyes) with one's hand
senses.example: Jeg holder for ørerne, når toget kører forbi.
senses.example_translation: I cover my ears when the train passes by.

senses.example: Jeg ligger over hos min veninde i weekenden.
senses.example_translation: I'm staying over at my friend's place this weekend.

senses.example: Hun bliver tilbage på kontoret, når de andre går hjem.
senses.example_translation: She stays behind in the office when the others go home.

senses.example: Jeg holdt mig tilbage, selvom jeg var vred.
senses.example_translation: I held back, even though I was angry.

senses.text: to play along (agree to someone's plan)
senses.example: Han spiller med på ideen om en tur til stranden.
senses.example_translation: He plays along with the idea of a trip to the beach.

senses.example: Bilen kørte ind i et træ.
senses.example_translation: The car crashed into a tree.

senses.example: Han slog i bordet af vrede.
senses.example_translation: He banged the table in anger.

senses.example: Jeg slog mig på knæet, da jeg faldt.
senses.example_translation: I hurt my knee when I fell.

senses.example: Hun mødte op til mødet uden sin computer.
senses.example_translation: She showed up for the meeting without her computer.

senses.example: De handler med frugt og grøntsager på torvet.
senses.example_translation: They trade in fruit and vegetables in the square.

senses.example: Jeg stiger af bussen ved stationen.
senses.example_translation: I get off the bus at the station.

senses.example: Børnene har lov til at lege i haven.
senses.example_translation: Children are allowed to play in the garden.

senses.example: Vi venter med mødet til i morgen.
senses.example_translation: We are postponing the meeting until tomorrow.

senses.text: to stand as a candidate (in an election)
senses.example: Hun stiller op til kommunalvalget næste år.
senses.example_translation: She is running in the municipal elections next year.

senses.example: Læreren bad børnene stille op på to rækker.
senses.example_translation: The teacher asked the children to line up in two rows.

senses.example: Huset ligger lige bag ved skolen.
senses.example_translation: The house is located right behind the school.

senses.example: Det hjælper på humøret at gå en tur.
senses.example_translation: Going for a walk helps your mood.

senses.example: Kan du flytte dig lidt til siden?
senses.example_translation: Can you move a little to the side?

senses.example: Min nabo flyttede ud i sidste uge.
senses.example_translation: My neighbour moved out last week.

senses.example: Hun retter på slipset før mødet.
senses.example_translation: She straightens her tie before the meeting.

senses.text: to go missing, to get lost
senses.example: Min nøgle bliver væk hele tiden.
senses.example_translation: My key gets lost all the time.

senses.example: Hun er igennem en svær periode lige nu.
senses.example_translation: She is going through a difficult period right now.

senses.text: to make a scene, to act up
senses.example: Børnene laver numre, når de er trætte.
senses.example_translation: The children act up when they are tired.

senses.example: De gik hen ad vejen i stilhed.
senses.example_translation: They walked along the road in silence.

senses.example: Tyven løb af med min taske.
senses.example_translation: The thief ran away with my bag.

senses.example: Hun løb af med førstepræmien.
senses.example_translation: She easily won the first prize.

senses.example: Jeg håber på godt vejr i morgen.
senses.example_translation: I hope for good weather tomorrow.

senses.example: Hun tager en beslutning om sit nye job i morgen.
senses.example_translation: She will make a decision about her new job tomorrow.

senses.example: Jeg kom i tvivl om svaret var rigtigt.
senses.example_translation: I started doubting whether the answer was correct.

senses.example: Vores hold er foran med to mål.
senses.example_translation: Our team is ahead by two goals.

senses.example: Alle børnene stemte i på omkvædet.
senses.example_translation: All the children joined in singing the chorus.

senses.example: Jeg skifter til en anden kanal.
senses.example_translation: I'm switching to a different channel.

senses.example: Han sad inde i to år for tyveri.
senses.example_translation: He was imprisoned for two years for theft.

senses.example: Hun sidder inde med vigtig viden om sagen.
senses.example_translation: She has important knowledge about the case.

senses.example: Jeg står inde for kvaliteten af vores produkter.
senses.example_translation: I vouch for the quality of our products.

senses.example: Jeg er inde i stuen og læser en bog.
senses.example_translation: I'm inside in the living room reading a book.

senses.text: to sign up (for a course, event)
senses.example: Jeg melder mig til et kursus i næste uge.
senses.example_translation: I'm signing up for a course next week.

senses.example: Passagererne gik fra borde i København.
senses.example_translation: The passengers disembarked in Copenhagen.

senses.example: Jeg slap af med min gamle sofa i går.
senses.example_translation: I got rid of my old couch yesterday.

senses.example: Hun synger med på sangen i radioen.
senses.example_translation: She sings along to the song on the radio.

senses.example: Vi tanker op inden den lange tur.
senses.example_translation: We refuel before the long trip.

senses.example: Jeg skar mig på kniven i går.
senses.example_translation: I cut myself on the knife yesterday.

senses.example: Vi skifter emne, fordi det er for pinligt.
senses.example_translation: We change the subject because it is too embarrassing.

senses.example: Du må styre dig, selvom du er vred.
senses.example_translation: You have to control yourself, even if you are angry.

senses.example: Vi snakker sammen hver aften.
senses.example_translation: We talk to each other every evening.

senses.example: Vi fejrer jul hos mine forældre i år.
senses.example_translation: We are celebrating Christmas at my parents' place this year.

senses.example: Jeg har brug for fred og ro efter arbejde.
senses.example_translation: I need peace and quiet after work.

senses.example: Vi tager på ferie til Italien hver sommer.
senses.example_translation: We go on holiday to Italy every summer.

senses.example: Hun sprang ind for den syge lærer i går.
senses.example_translation: She stepped in for the sick teacher yesterday.

senses.text: to put up with, to tolerate
senses.example: Hun finder sig i meget fra sin chef.
senses.example_translation: She puts up with a lot from her boss.
